_doc: Barnaby Bellows announcer lines (docs/design/ANNOUNCER_AND_TUTORIAL.md §1.1). Each item: id (stable), speaker, trigger (Audio.announce_trigger key), when (every key must match the trigger context; absent = generic), priority (interrupt rules in §1.2), text (subtitle, <= 90 chars; {p} player, {o} opponent, {n} number, {a} arena). Mods add lines with the same format in announcer/*.json (ids prefixed modid:).

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Eighty-five kilos of newt and a furnace where his conscience should be: STOKE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He's been angry since birth, folks. Birth was a Tuesday. Here's STOKE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: From the dock, by way of the dock, going back to the dock: DREDGE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: One hundred sixty kilos and a chain. He brought the chain. DREDGE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He flew in. He'll fly out. He will absolutely tell you about it: GUSTO!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Fifty-five kilos, forty of it hairdo. Make some noise for GUSTO!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He has one plan. The plan is forward. Here comes DOZER!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Please clear the front row. Please clear the second row. DOZER!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Up from the drain, folks, and the drain is glad: SLURRY!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Don't touch the floor near it. Don't touch anything near it. SLURRY!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Forty-five kilos and nine thousand volts of nerves: it's JITTERS!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He's not scared, folks, he's just like that. Give it up for JITTERS!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Touch gloves, claws, beaks, whatever you've got, and FIGHT!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The Gullet is open for business, folks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Round {n}! Somebody's cornerman is lying to them right now.
items.retired: assumes a cornerman; replaced by cmt17 round calls

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Last round. Glandco reminds you hydration is legally a choice.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Bell! Go! That's the whole rulebook!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Card's live, {p}. Make the undercard remember you.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: First touch! Somebody tell the judges to wake up!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And we're off, folks. That one counted. They all count.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p} lands first! The crowd approves, loudly, with cans!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {o} gets there first. Shake it off, {p}, you've got plenty of face left.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: FIRST hit of the night and it was a big one! That's a mission statement!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: OH! That one came with a return address!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: HE FELT THAT in the parking lot!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That's a Glandco Heavy Hit of the Night, folks, and it is NOT even night!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Fully charged! Somebody check the cage for dents!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Physics just filed a complaint!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: INTO THE SPONSOR BOARD! The sponsor is thrilled!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: UP goes the critter! Gravity's turn now!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Oof. Okay. That's gonna be a photo on the wall, {p}.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caught him WINDING UP! That's a counter, folks, that's reading the mail!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Fifteen-plus! The commissioner is pretending not to look!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: One, two, THREE! That's arithmetic, folks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: FINISHER! And the follow-through had a follow-through!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Four in a row! Somebody's been doing their bag work!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p} closes the string! Granny's gonna want that on tape!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: SIX hits! The judges are just drawing little hearts now!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And the combo's done, folks, that's the rules. Even here we have one rule.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: PARRIED! Timed to the hair!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That's a read, folks! He saw it before it was thrown!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p} slaps it away! Now hit him back, kid, he's wide open!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A HEAVY, parried! That's a crime in six districts!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {o} read you like a sponsor card, {p}. Mix it up!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Third parry! Someone's gonna have to just stand there and take it.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: DOWN! Down goes the critter!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Timber, folks! That's a full ragdoll!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Legs said no! The rest of him agreed!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p} puts him on the canvas! Let him up or don't, I'm not the ref!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p} is down, folks. Wake-up window. Get up smart, not fast.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: THROWN! He's gonna land in a different weight class!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tripped! It's the little ones that get you!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Three knockdowns! The canvas is filing for a restraining order!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: WAIT a minute! He's not done! He's NOT done, folks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Where is this coming from?! Not Glandco, I checked!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p} is BACK in it! Crowd's on its feet! The seats are on their feet!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {o} is swinging back, {p}! Nobody in this cage ever reads the script!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He was DEAD and buried and he took the ROUND! I need a minute!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: MELTDOWN! The door's open and the newt's not home!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Stoke hits the JUICE! Fire marshal, please report to the Gullet!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: HIGH TIDE! Everybody's ankles just got heavy!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dredge hits the JUICE! The dock is in the cage now!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: HURRICANE STRUT! He's faster and, somehow, louder!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gusto hits the JUICE and the hairdo achieves liftoff!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: LANDSLIDE! Please move your vehicles!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dozer hits the JUICE! He has become a road!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: OVERFLOW! Evacuate the floor! The floor is leaving anyway!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry hits the JUICE! Nobody drink from the drain this week!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: OVERCHARGE! The jelly is BIGGER and that's a problem for everyone!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Jitters hits the JUICE! That hum is coming from inside the building!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He's running on fumes and sponsor obligations!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p}'s hurt, folks. Guard up, breathe, pick your shot.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {o} is one good shot from the wall of fame! The sad part of the wall!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Both of them! Whoever blinks loses and nobody in here has eyelids!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ten percent! That's a rounding error with legs!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p}'s hurt! Partner, that's your cue, that's the whole cue!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ten seconds! The judges are reaching for their coins!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Time! Goes to the cards, and the cards say {p}. Don't ask what cards.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: SUDDEN DEATH! One hit, folks! Everyone is made of glass! Be the hammer!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: ONE TOUCH and it's over! That's the most honest thing this league does!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ref timeout! Somebody's shoe came off. Somebody who doesn't wear shoes.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: IT'S OVER! Goodnight, good luck, and good grief!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: KNOCKED OUT! Call Doc Sutura! Call her gently!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: KO by HEAVY! That's a headline, folks, I'll write it myself!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: KO by THROW! He went from fighter to luggage!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: KO by the JUICE! Glandco would like you to know it's "probably fine"!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He got burned out, folks! The floor did the paperwork!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And {p} is OUT. Chin up, kid. The dog started somewhere too.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: AND THERE GOES A PIECE OF HIM! Somebody grab that, it's a souvenir!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Under thirty seconds! Refunds are not available, that's in the waiver!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: OFF THE ROOF! He's fine! Probably! It's a tall building!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: STOKE takes it! Somebody open a window, the newt's still cooking!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your winner, by furnace: STOKE! He'd like to thank nobody!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: DREDGE wins! He will now return to the dock and feel nothing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your winner, by tonnage: DREDGE! The chain stays on!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: GUSTO wins and he knew it an hour ago!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your winner, by altitude: GUSTO! He's taking a bow! He's taking three!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: DOZER wins! Now somebody turn him around!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your winner, in a straight line: DOZER! Good lad! Good LAD!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: SLURRY wins! Please do not shake its hand, it doesn't have one!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your winner, by puddle: SLURRY! Mop crew, you have my sympathies!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: JITTERS wins and he's just as surprised as you are!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your winner, by voltage: JITTERS! Unplug him before the ceremony!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The cannery's own guard dog! Three hundred twenty kilos of good boy: BILGE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He's on a chain, folks. The chain is a suggestion. BILGE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: HE'S OFF THE CHAIN! And he pulled the PLUG! Everybody's wet! Everybody!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: From the power cabinet, the one with the warning sticker: CONDUIT!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Do not touch the serpent. Do not touch the floor. CONDUIT!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: IT'S PLUGGED IN! The floor is a weapon now! The rubber mats are your friends!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Undefeated since nineteen seventy-three! Her Honor, COMMISSIONER SNAPPINGTON!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: She wrote the rules, folks. Tonight she's reading them to you. SNAPPINGTON!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: SHE DRANK THE CRATE! The whole crate! That's not in the rules! She knows!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Needles has a stall up. Everything's legal. He said so. He's sweating.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Doc's table. Eight hands, one opinion. Hold still.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Something's happening on the card, folks. Something always is.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Question mark node! My favorite punctuation! After the exclamation!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Elite bout! That's a star on the poster and a bruise on you!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A crate! Nobody's name on it! That makes it yours, that's maritime law!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A Banned Substance! I saw nothing! I'm a pelican, I see fish!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Boss bout. Folks, I'm going to need the big microphone. The BIG one.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Take your time, kid. The cage isn't going anywhere. The cage is bolted down.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Glandco JUICE: it's probably fine. That's the slogan. They paid for that.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: I've called four thousand fights. Three of them had a referee.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The weight classes are decorative, folks. So is the drug testing.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Pick the crab. Nobody picks the crab. The crab notices.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: If you're waiting for a sign, folks, the sign fell off the roof in March.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: My jacket has eleven hundred sequins. I counted during a Dredge fight.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The Commissioner says hello. She didn't, but she would, legally.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tutorial's under Practice, kid. Granny's waiting. Granny's always waiting.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gusto has asked me to mention Gusto. Consider Gusto mentioned.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Fun fact: the Gullet has eight sides and zero fire exits. Allegedly.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Still here? Me too, folks. Forty years. The booth has a cot.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: New kid in the practice cage! Granny's got 'em! Granny's got everybody!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Three hits! Folks, we have a prospect!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: THAT'S a heavy! Even the bag felt bad about it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Guard's up! That's the second-best advice in this building!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slipped it! Nothing hits what isn't there, kid!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: An ABILITY! It's got a cooldown, folks, same as my knees!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: PARRIED! Granny, did you SEE that? She saw it. She's not smiling. She is inside.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tutorial done! Folks, I'd put money on this one! Teddy, I'd put SCRIP on it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: OVER THE EDGE! The next roof will be in touch!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p} goes off the roof! You get a do-over, kid, this league is merciful once!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: THE WIND did that! The weather is undefeated!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: BOTH of them! Off opposite sides! That's symmetry! I love symmetry!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: REACTION! That's chemistry, folks, that's the part I failed!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: FLARE-UP! The puddle went BOOM! The puddle was ambitious!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: SHORT-OUT! Water plus volts! Every parent told you!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: STORMFRONT! Move! Move! Oh, he didn't move!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He's TAUNTING! That's Hype in the bank, or a mistake, we'll see!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Taunt, PUNISHED! Confidence is a resource, folks, and he spent it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gusto's taunting again! He has a tab at the taunt bar!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Taunting at ten percent! That's either courage or a concussion!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A DRAW! Nobody wins! Everybody's mad! Welcome to the Circuit!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dead even! The judges have left! They may have never arrived!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The light's moving, folks! Follow the light! The light is the money!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: GOAL! A bale of chum crossed a line and I have never been happier!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: NEW UNIT! He drank the crate! He IS the crate!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: WAVE TEN! Bargain night's headliner is here! Did we pay him? We did not!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here comes the trash, folks! Respectfully! They're trying their best!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And bargain night claims another! Cheap seats, expensive lesson!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: SCRAPLING into SCRAPLING! Recycling! Glandco is very proud!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He threw the BLISTER! That's a bomb with feelings, folks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ten down! Somebody's clearing the undercard like a buffet!
